// PATROL-DIAGNOSIS repro: the post-#3988 production signature, end to end.
// Store: one healthy room + one room whose stored projection is torn.
// Variant A: torn projection CONTAINS the "messagesArchive" substring
//   -> snapshot archiveMarker() json_extract throws a plain Error.
// Variant B: torn projection without the substring (the #3988 test shape)
//   -> agreements-leg JSON.parse throws SyntaxError.
// Then: fresh-park tick, standing-park tick, head move (raw event append,
// the importEvents table-level shape), health view via the real
// cloudflare/job-heartbeat.mjs grading.
import { mkdtempSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { RoomStore } from "__R1ROOT__/server/store.mjs";
import { initialRoom } from "__R1ROOT__/server/bootstrap.mjs";
import { patrolPending, patrolBlocks } from "__R1ROOT__/server/patrol.mjs";
import { jobByName } from "__R1ROOT__/server/jobs.mjs";
import { applyOutcomes, jobHealthView, runCronJobs } from "__R1ROOT__/cloudflare/job-heartbeat.mjs";
import { event as makeEvent, EVENT_TYPES } from "__R1ROOT__/src/events.js";

const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "patrol-diag-"));
const store = new RoomStore(join(dir, "room.sqlite"));
store.initialize(initialRoom("zzz-healthy"));

function post(roomId, id, body) {
  const key = store.issueAccessKey(roomId, "owner");
  store.command(key, roomId, { id: `cmd-${id}`, type: "message.posted", data: { body, messageId: id } });
}
const headOf = roomId => store.db.prepare("SELECT sequence FROM rooms WHERE id=?").get(roomId).sequence;

function moveHeadRaw(roomId, messageId) {
  const seq = headOf(roomId) + 1;
  const raw = makeEvent({
    id: randomUUID(), idempotencyKey: randomUUID(), type: EVENT_TYPES.MESSAGE_POSTED,
    actorId: "owner", roomId, at: new Date().toISOString(),
    data: { messageId, body: `appended ${messageId}` }
  });
  store.db.prepare("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?,?,?)").run(roomId, seq, raw.id, JSON.stringify(raw));
  store.db.prepare("UPDATE rooms SET sequence=? WHERE id=?").run(seq, roomId);
  return seq;
}

// Drive the real job wiring into the real health view, as production does.
const patrolJob = jobByName("patrol");
let records = {};
async function tickAndGrade(label, at) {
  const outcomes = await runCronJobs(
    { patrol: () => patrolJob.run(store, { deadline: Date.now() + 5000 }) },
    { now: () => at, log: () => {} }
  );
  records = applyOutcomes(records, outcomes);
  const view = jobHealthView(records, at, {}, store);
  const entry = view.jobs.find(j => j.name === "patrol");
  console.log(`\n== ${label} ==`);
  console.log("tick result:", JSON.stringify(outcomes[0]?.summary ?? outcomes[0]));
  console.log("health:", JSON.stringify({
    status: entry.status, reason: entry.reason, consecutiveFailures: entry.consecutiveFailures,
    lastSuccessAt: entry.lastSuccessAt, lastError: entry.lastError,
    lastErrorCurrent: entry.lastErrorCurrent, lastErrorClass: entry.lastErrorClass,
    lastErrorCode: entry.lastErrorCode
  }));
  return outcomes[0];
}

try {
  post("zzz-healthy", "h1", "healthy one");
  post("zzz-healthy", "h2", "healthy two");

  // ---- Variant A: torn projection containing the archive-marker key ----
  store.initialize(initialRoom("aaa-corrupt-a"));
  post("aaa-corrupt-a", "a1", "first");
  post("aaa-corrupt-a", "a2", "second");
  const realA = store.db.prepare("SELECT projection FROM rooms WHERE id='aaa-corrupt-a'").get().projection;
  // A torn multi-key projection: valid prefix incl. the messagesArchive key, cut mid-stream.
  const tornA = realA.slice(0, 40) + ',"messagesArchive":{"throughSeq":2,"count":1,"retainedIds":["a1"';
  store.db.prepare("UPDATE rooms SET projection=? WHERE id='aaa-corrupt-a'").run(tornA);

  const t1 = await tickAndGrade("A tick 1 (fresh park expected)", 1_000_000);
  console.log("blocks:", JSON.stringify(patrolBlocks(store).map(b => ({ room: b.roomId, errorClass: b.errorClass, error: b.error, headSeq: b.headSeq }))));
  console.log("patrolPending after park:", patrolPending(store));

  const t2 = await tickAndGrade("A tick 2 (standing park, head unchanged)", 2_000_000);
  console.log("tick2 ok:", t2.ok, "| summary errors field:", t2.summary?.errors);

  moveHeadRaw("aaa-corrupt-a", "a3");
  const t3 = await tickAndGrade("A tick 3 (head moved -> one retry, fresh park)", 3_000_000);
  console.log("blocks after head move:", JSON.stringify(patrolBlocks(store).map(b => ({ room: b.roomId, errorClass: b.errorClass, headSeq: b.headSeq }))));

  const t4 = await tickAndGrade("A tick 4 (standing again)", 4_000_000);
  console.log("tick4 ok:", t4.ok);

  // Healthy-room activity alone while the corrupt room stands parked:
  post("zzz-healthy", "h3", "healthy three");
  const t5 = await tickAndGrade("tick 5 (healthy activity only -> success; the 16:32Z analogue)", 5_000_000);
  console.log("tick5 ok:", t5.ok);

  // One more corrupt-room event: the success streak dies again.
  moveHeadRaw("aaa-corrupt-a", "a4");
  const t6 = await tickAndGrade("tick 6 (corrupt room event -> failure resumes)", 6_000_000);
  console.log("tick6 ok:", t6.ok);

  // ---- Variant B: torn projection, no marker substring (#3988 test shape) ----
  store.initialize(initialRoom("bbb-corrupt-b"));
  post("bbb-corrupt-b", "b1", "first");
  store.db.prepare("UPDATE rooms SET projection=? WHERE id='bbb-corrupt-b'").run("{corrupt-projection");
  const tb = await tickAndGrade("B tick (fresh park, SyntaxError expected)", 7_000_000);
  console.log("blocks:", JSON.stringify(patrolBlocks(store).map(b => ({ room: b.roomId, errorClass: b.errorClass }))));
} finally {
  store.close();
}
